sources.title: GitHub - mx4ai/qwen2.5: Qwen2.5 is the large language model series ...
sources.snippet: Today, we are excited to introduce the latest addition to the Qwen family: Qwen2.5. Dense, easy-to-use, decoder-only language models, available in 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B, 32B, and 72B sizes, and base and instruct variants. Pretrained on our latest large-scale dataset, encompassing up to 18T tokens.

sources.title: qwen2.5:7b - ollama.com
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5 is the latest series of Qwen large language models. For Qwen2.5, a range of base language models and instruction-tuned models are released, with sizes ranging from 0.5 to 72 billion parameters.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-7B: Specifications and GPU VRAM Requirements
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-7B is a foundational large language model developed by Alibaba Cloud, forming a part of the Qwen2.5 series. This model is a causal language model engineered for general-purpose applications, serving as a robust base for subsequent fine-tuning and specialized tasks.
